Use approximate formula: difference in latitude ~12.8°, difference in longitude ~250.2° (since 127.8E to 122.4W is 127.8+122.4=250.2). Use haversine. Let's approximate: radius Earth ~6371 km. Compute central angle: a = sin^2(dlat/2)+cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*sin^2(dlon/2). dlat=12.8°=0.2236 rad. dlon=250.2°=4.368 rad. sin^2(dlat/2)=sin^2(0.1118)= (0.1116)^2=0.0125. cos(lat1)=cos(50.6°)=0.636. cos(lat2)=cos(37.8°)=0.788. sin^2(dlon/2)=sin^2(2.184)= (sin(2.184))^2. sin(2.184)=0.818. squared=0.669.
